|game_text=Deploy on your [Reflections 2] objective; "Xizor" on it (and on [[Guri]]) is treated as "Shada." Non-[Permanent Weapon] alien females are Mistryl and Black Sun agents. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 2). The images here, the release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image, print it. The current text is [[No Bargain (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1).
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 4 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 32E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on your [Reflections 2] objective; "Xizor" on it (and on Guri) is treated as "Shada." Non-[Permanent Weapon] alien females are Mistryl and Black Sun agents. You may not deploy cards with ability except Mistryl and [Independent Starship] starships. Mistryl (except Kitik) are power +1 (+2 if unique (•)) and, while Scum And Villainy on table, deploy +1. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-32E-No_Bargain.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-nobargain-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Dark Side p. 29)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character: a stale reprint, not a new version, and it does not make this text current again.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[No Bargain (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 4 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1240_34">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on your [Reflections 2] Objective; "Xizor" on it (and on Guri) is treated as "Shada". Non-[Permanent Weapon] alien females are Mistryl and Black Sun agents. You may not deploy cards with ability except Mistryl and [Independent Starship] starships. Mistryl (except Kitik) are power +1 (+2 if unique (•)), and, while Scum And Villainy on table, deploy +1. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Three changes: “objective” is written “Objective”, with a capital O; the full stop after “Shada” moves outside the closing quote mark (“Shada.” becomes “Shada”.); and a comma is added after “(+2 if unique (•))”. The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1240_34">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes.
